name: wallstreetsahead-data
description: Downloads the WallStreetsAhead.ai ETF mover reports to a folder on your computer, so Claude can analyse the latest market data.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: Your personal WallStreetsAhead.ai API key. See the plugin README for how to get one. Leave blank if the Windows installer already saved it.

data_folder.title: Data folder
data_folder.description: Where the reports are saved. Leave blank for C:\WallStreetsAhead on Windows or ~/WallStreetsAhead on macOS and Linux.

api_url.title: API URL
api_url.description: The WallStreetsAhead.ai API gateway. Leave blank to use https://api.wallstreetsahead.ai/ClaudeCodePlugin.
